thread:
jon: FYI starting migration: add index on orders(created_at) to speed reporting. change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. tagging @claire for rollout and @nina for rollback owner.

claire: acknowledged. canary on shard-A at 23:05. will monitor index build locks and replica lag.

deploybot: migration scheduled: idx_orders_created_at_2026 on db-runner-2. auto-pause on exclusive_lock>15s or replica_lag>10s.

srebot: alert: index build holding lock 18s on shard-A at 23:07:12, auto-pause triggered.

nina: What's blocking? any long txn?

claire: looks like a batch write from billing overlapped. asked infra to pause the job; holding until it's quiesced.

deploybot: operator hold requested by claire, reason="pausing conflicting billing write". manual unblock allowed.

infra-bot: billing job paused (job-id 4421). replica lag 3s.

claire: suggestion: retry index build on the shard, but switch to CONCURRENTLY method for remaining shards to avoid exclusive locks. nina, if we need to rollback, plan is DROP INDEX concurrently and revert client pin.

nina: agree. proceed with retry on shard-A. I'll be on-call to run DROP CONCURRENTLY if thresholds breach.

deploybot: retry completed at 23:12:15. CONCURRENTLY build initiated for remaining shards. no exclusive locks observed.

jon: status good. will update release notes with concurrent-index note and rollback contact. closing after 00:00 UTC unless any alerts.
